findings.source_quote: I’ll plan not for a life / That I might live in ease, / But only for today to live / My God alone to please.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Sitapanga maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitajitahidi kuishi leo / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake.” with “Sitaweka mipango ya maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitaishi kwa ajili ya leo tu / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake.”
findings.translation_quote: Sitapanga maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitajitahidi kuishi leo / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake.

findings.source_quote: Nor dare I think in years / Or move from leaps to bounds; / With God shut out, and self shut in / And selfish aims surround.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Wala sitathubutu kufikiria kwa miaka mingi / Au kupiga hatua kubwa; / Mungu akiwa ametengwa, na nafsi yangu ikiwa imefungiwa ndani, / Nikiwa nimezingirwa na malengo ya ubinafsi.” with “Wala sitathubutu kuwaza kwa miaka mingi / Au kuruka hatua kubwa; / Huku nikimwacha Mungu nje na kujifungia ndani yangu mwenyewe, / Nikiwa nimezungukwa na malengo ya ubinafsi.”
findings.translation_quote: Wala sitathubutu kufikiria kwa miaka mingi / Au kupiga hatua kubwa; / Mungu akiwa ametengwa, na nafsi yangu ikiwa imefungiwa ndani, / Nikiwa nimezingirwa na malengo ya ubinafsi.

findings.source_quote: Who weigh themselves, not with God’s truth, / As every day they ought!
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Wanaojipima, si kwa kweli ya Mungu, / Ingawa ndivyo wanavyopaswa kufanya kila siku!” with “Wanaojipima, si kwa ukweli wa Mungu, / Kama wanavyopaswa kufanya kila siku!”
findings.translation_quote: Wanaojipima, si kwa kweli ya Mungu, / Ingawa ndivyo wanavyopaswa kufanya kila siku!

findings.source_quote: And dost thou plan the New Year full / There, ‘neath some Christmas tree?
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Je, unapanga mwaka mpya mzima / Huko, chini ya mti fulani wa Krismasi?” with “Na je, unapanga mwaka mzima ujao / Huko, chini ya mti fulani wa Krismasi?”
findings.translation_quote: Je, unapanga mwaka mpya mzima / Huko, chini ya mti fulani wa Krismasi?”
